scope: Android accessibility and large-font audit of the installed host through the public accessibility tree

decisions.audit_completed: all 15 declared cases ran and every named tree, screenshot and identity record exists and matches
decisions.accessibility_accepted: false because four declared requirements failed; a completed audit is not an accessibility pass

findings.requirement: a changed status must be announced
findings.minimal_patch: android:accessibilityLiveRegion="polite" on status_text and reader_status in res/layout/activity_main.xml

findings.observed: reader_view advertises no ACTION_SCROLL_FORWARD/BACKWARD and the tree contains no next/previous control
findings.requirement: a screen reader user must be able to change pages
findings.minimal_patch: add both scroll actions in ReaderView.onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo and route performAccessibilityAction to listener.onTapZone(1)/onTapZone(-1)

findings.observed: font_up is named 'Increase font size' with an empty state description while font_label shows 'Size 24'
findings.requirement: a control must expose the value it changes (WCAG 4.1.2)
findings.minimal_patch: set a state description (or include the size in the content description) on font_up/font_down in MainActivity.applyPage

findings.observed: the organizer overlays the shelf while the shelf controls stay in the accessibility tree; recorded overlap pairs include Close~import_button, Kind~refresh_button, Saved intent~more_button, Cancel~book_list
findings.requirement: no interactive control may be covered by another control of the same window
findings.minimal_patch: hide shelf_panel from accessibility (IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO_HIDE_DESCENDANTS) while the organizer is visible, or host it in a dialog window
